assertion.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 denies cross-namespace protection Usages that do not set "by". The exact API group and field path are not stated.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The release note only says 'protection.Usages' and 'w/o by'. It doesn't give the API group or the schema path of the 'by' field, or explain what 'across namespace' means, so the crd-field identity can't be pinned from the evidence.; applicability: The evidence doesn't say which Usage field shapes count as 'across namespace' or give the exact path of 'by', so no resource/field predicate can be written without inventing it.; consequence: The terse title says such Usages are 'denied' but doesn't say whether existing objects are affected or only new ones, or what an operator must do.
